testcase.name: off and end-of-track arm no deadline, because neither is a time
a name that is nothing but padding still gets something to show, by position
minutes left round UP, so a running timer never claims zero
the menu entry says what the timer is doing
the choices are the quarter hours and the end of the track
a deadline that has passed has no minutes left
a clean name is left alone apart from surrounding space
the equaliser entry names the preset in use, or says off
a preset name padded with NULs is cut at the first one
an expired deadline reads as no timer rather than as zero minutes
a minutes choice arms a deadline that many minutes out on the same clock
